record.paper_title: Open problems in the theory of non-uniform hyperbolicity
record.context_brief: Residual genericity near an almost-everywhere non-uniformly hyperbolic conservative map
record.original_question: Suppose f is a C^{1+α} diffeomorphism in Diff^{1+α}(M, μ) whose Lyapunov exponents are nonzero μ-almost everywhere. Must there exist an open neighbourhood U of f in Diff^{1+α}(M, μ) such that H ∩ U is residual in U, where H is the set of volume-preserving C^{1+α} diffeomorphisms having nonzero Lyapunov exponents on a set of positive μ-measure?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 4.4. If f ∈ Diff1+α(M, µ) has non-zero Lyapunov exponents µ-a.e., then there exists an open neighbourhood U ⊂ Diff1+α(M, µ) of f such that the set H ∩ U is residual in U.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth compact Riemannian manifold equipped with a smooth volume form $\mu$, and let $\alpha\in(0,1)$. Denote by $\mathrm{Diff}^{1+\alpha}(M,\mu)$ the space of $\mu$-preserving $C^{1+\alpha}$ diffeomorphisms of $M$, endowed with the $C^{1+\alpha}$ topology. For $f\in\mathrm{Diff}^{1+\alpha}(M,\mu)$ and $\mu$-almost every $x\in M$, the Oseledets theorem assigns Lyapunov exponents $\lambda_1(f,x)\geq\cdots\geq\lambda_{\dim M}(f,x)$. Let 
$$H=\{\,g\in\mathrm{Diff}^{1+\alpha}(M,\mu) : \mu(\{x\in M : \lambda_i(g,x)\neq 0\text{ for some }i\})>0\,\}$$
be the set of volume-preserving $C^{1+\alpha}$ diffeomorphisms with nonzero Lyapunov exponents on a set of positive $\mu$-measure. A subset of a topological space is called residual in an open set $U$ if it contains a countable intersection of open dense subsets of $U$.

Suppose $f\in\mathrm{Diff}^{1+\alpha}(M,\mu)$ has nonzero Lyapunov exponents at $\mu$-almost every point. Must there exist an open neighbourhood $U\subset\mathrm{Diff}^{1+\alpha}(M,\mu)$ of $f$ such that $H\cap U$ is residual in $U$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is stated as a conjecture about the local genericity of having nonzero Lyapunov exponents on a positive-measure set in the $C^{1+\alpha}$ volume-preserving category. In the $C^1$ topology, Bochi–Mañé's theorem implies the opposite phenomenon (generic vanishing of exponents away from Anosov), highlighting the contrast with higher regularity. No proof in the $C^{1+\alpha}$ category appears in the literature, and the question seems to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The Lyapunov exponents of generic volume-preserving ... (Bochi–Viana)
status_evidence.snippet: C^1-generic volume preserving diffeomorphisms are either Anosov or have all Lyapunov exponents zero almost everywhere.
status_evidence.claim: Highlights that the $C^1$ genericity result goes the opposite direction; the $C^{1+\alpha}$ analogue is conjectural and open.

status_evidence.title: Genericity of zero Lyapunov exponents (Bochi)
status_evidence.snippet: Proves $C^1$-genericity of vanishing exponents for surface area-preserving diffeomorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes a $C^1$ result, not a $C^{1+\alpha}$ result; the conjecture in question concerns $C^{1+\alpha}$ regularity and remains unverified.
